# ca

```go
import "github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/internal/ca"
```

Package ca is segredium's built\-in local certificate authority.

A self\-signed ECDSA P\-256 root is kept as ca.crt.pem/ca.key.pem in tls.ca\_dir. The HTTPS listener asks the CA for a certificate during the TLS handshake \(SNI\) and the CA mints and caches a short\-lived leaf for the requested hostname. Redirecting secretsmanager.\<region\>.amazonaws.com to segredium in /etc/hosts therefore works with any stock SDK once the root certificate is trusted.

It implements api.TLSProvider \(tls.mode=ca\), wired in internal/app/wire\_tls.go.

## Constants

<a name="CertFileName"></a>

```go
const (
    // CertFileName is the root certificate's PEM file inside Options.Dir.
    CertFileName = "ca.crt.pem"
    // KeyFileName is the root private key's PEM file inside Options.Dir.
    KeyFileName = "ca.key.pem"

    // DefaultCACommonName is the root certificate's subject CN.
    DefaultCACommonName = "segredium local CA"
    // DefaultCAValidity is the root certificate's lifetime.
    DefaultCAValidity = 10 * 365 * 24 * time.Hour
    // DefaultLeafValidity is how long a minted leaf is valid. Short-lived leaves are
    // re-minted from the long-lived root, so a leaked leaf goes stale quickly.
    DefaultLeafValidity = 24 * time.Hour
)
```

<a name="Create"></a>
### func [Create](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/ca/ca.go#L136>)

```go
func Create(opts Options) (*CA, error)
```

Create generates a new root CA in opts.Dir. Existing root files are never replaced, including when two server processes try to initialize the directory concurrently.

func Ensure(opts Options) (*CA, error)

Ensure loads the CA in opts.Dir, creating a new root when nothing is there yet.

<a name="Load"></a>
### func [Load](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/ca/ca.go#L207>)

```go
func Load(opts Options) (*CA, error)
```

Load reads an existing CA from opts.Dir. Only a directory with neither root file is reported as os.ErrNotExist, so Ensure can distinguish absent and broken CAs.

<a name="NewCA"></a>
### func [NewCA](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/ca/ca.go#L110>)

```go
func NewCA(cfg *config.Config) (*CA, error)
```

NewCA loads the CA configured by cfg.TLS, creating and persisting a new root if none exists yet \("auto\-created on serve"\). A partially written CA is an error, never silently replaced.

<a name="Options"></a>
## type [Options](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/ca/ca.go#L60-L76>)

Options configures a CA. Dir is required; the other fields have defaults.

```go
type Options struct {
    // Dir holds the root certificate and key.
    Dir string
    // CommonName is the root certificate's subject CN.
    CommonName string
    // Validity is the root certificate's lifetime.
    Validity time.Duration
    // DefaultRegion names the endpoint minted when a client sends no SNI (e.g. dialing
    // an IP address). Empty makes such handshakes fail instead.
    DefaultRegion string
    // LeafValidity overrides DefaultLeafValidity for minted certificates.
    LeafValidity time.Duration
    // Now is the time source (tests inject a fake clock); defaults to time.Now.
    Now func() time.Time
    // Rand is the randomness source for keys and serial numbers; defaults to crypto/rand.
    Rand io.Reader
}
```
